{"search_note":"The evidence base does not show a clear, economy-wide or society-wide improvement in ordinary people’s life chances in 2024. What exists is mostly:
- partial program-level positives,
- executive announcements or reform intent,
- and a few localized improvements in education, cash transfers, water, or ceasefire conditions.

What is missing is stronger proof of durable, broad gains such as:
- nationwide reductions in hunger, displacement, abuse, or repression,
- sustained improvement in school quality, health access, or income security,
- or independent evidence that reforms outlast Tshisekedi’s personal sponsorship.","evidence":[{"title":"Democratic Republic of the Congo: Expanding and Equipping Primary School Classrooms for Better Learning Outcomes","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-02-28","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/02/28/democratic-republic-of-congo-afe-expanding-and-equipping-primary-school-classrooms-for-better-learning-outcomes","summary":"The education project was designed around better learning conditions, merit-based teacher recruitment, decentralized planning, and support for girls and students with disabilities. This is one of the clearest positive signals that policy was aimed at improving ordinary children’s life chances, not just headline growth.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9","6B.2"]},{"title":"IMF Executive Board Completes the Sixth Review Under the ECF Arrangement for the Democratic Republic of the Congo","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/03/pr24253-drc-imf-exec-board-concludes-2024-art-iv-consult-completes-6th-rev-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said social spending rose, education and health were prioritized, free primary education expanded access, and the civil-service register was cleaned up with biometrics. This supports a limited improvement in state capacity and service reach, though the IMF also said reforms were still slow and social protection remained weak.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.5","6B.8","6B.2"]},{"title":"DRC: IMF Reaches Agreement on ECF and RSF","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/11/13/pr-24416-drc-imf-reaches-agreement-on-ecf-and-rsf","summary":"The new IMF package emphasized inclusive growth, governance, poverty reduction, tighter spending controls, and decentralizing some spending authorization. That is credible evidence of a reform agenda that could, in principle, improve life chances beyond raw macro stability.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.4","6B.5"]},{"title":"Congo’s president appoints country’s first female prime minister","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dr-congo-president-appoints-countrys-first-female-prime-minister-2024-04-01/","summary":"Appointing Judith Suminwa, a technocratic planning minister, as prime minister is real but limited inclusion evidence. It suggests some willingness to staff the top government with competence and broaden representation, which modestly helps ordinary citizens if it translates into execution.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9","6B.7"]},{"title":"Biographie de la Première Ministre","publisher":"Primature","date":"2024","url":"https://www.primature.gouv.cd/biographie-de-la-premiere-ministre/","summary":"Suminwa’s biography emphasizes applied economics, banking, UN/PNUD work, budget-ministry experience, and development-planning leadership. That strengthens the reading that the appointment was competence-based rather than purely patronage-based.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.4","6B.5","6B.7"]},{"title":"UNICEF cash transfers help build community resilience","publisher":"UNICEF DRC","date":"2024-06-18","url":"https://www.unicef.org/drcongo/en/stories/unicef-cash-transfers-help-build-community-resilience","summary":"UNICEF described cash transfers helping families eat better, keep children in school, and access health care. This is meaningful welfare evidence for poor households, but it is limited in scale and does not show a broad state-wide lift in life chances.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.2"]},{"title":"Water sector taking stock of challenges leads to new solutions","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-06-10","url":"https://connect4impact.worldbank.org/topic/democratic-republic-congo-water-sector-taking-stock-challenges-leads-new-solutions","summary":"The PASEA program aimed to expand drinking water and sanitation access in selected provinces. This is a concrete but localized improvement that could matter for ordinary life chances, especially in poorer areas, but it remained early-stage.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.2","6B.8"]},{"title":"P-DDRCS: programme de désarmement et de démobilisation","publisher":"ACP","date":"2024-03-22","url":"https://acp.cd/nation/programme-de-desarmement-et-demobilisation-une-alternative-pour-la-paix-et-la-cohesion-sociale/","summary":"The government framed P-DDRCS as a stabilization and cohesion program intended to restore state authority where absent. That is evidence of an institutional response to insecurity that could improve life chances indirectly, but it is still an indirect and partial mechanism.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.3","6B.6"]},{"title":"Tshisekedi relaunches Nairobi and Luanda peace processes","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-03-25","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_salva_kiir_appellent_au-respect_des_accords_de_paix","summary":"Tshisekedi publicly called for peace-process renewal and said he would spare no effort to restore peace, security, and stability. That is relevant because civilian safety and conflict de-escalation are preconditions for better life chances, especially in the east.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.3","6B.6","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Tshisekedi backs Luanda ceasefire","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-08-12","url":"https://presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/crise_securitaire_dans_lest_de_la_rdc_les_presidents_felix_tshisekedi_et_joao_lourenco_appellent_au-respect_du_cessez_le_feu","summary":"He publicly backed the Luanda ceasefire and negotiation steps. This is positive evidence for reduced conflict pressure, but it did not yet amount to durable protection or a stable peace dividend for ordinary people.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.3","6B.6","6B.7"]},{"title":"Collective effort essential to get DR Congo on firm path to peace","publisher":"UN Office at Geneva","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.ungeneva.org/en/news-media/news/2024/09/98156/collective-effort-essential-get-dr-congo-firm-path-peace","summary":"The UN said fighting had decreased after the 30 July ceasefire and a dialogue framework was active. That is one of the best pieces of positive context for life chances, because less fighting can translate into safer mobility and better access to services.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.3","6B.6"]},{"title":"Human Rights Watch: DRC world report chapter","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/democratic-republic-congo","summary":"HRW said conflict, civilian killings, repression, and weak reform performance continued through 2024. This is strong counterevidence that most ordinary people were not left better off in a durable, broad-based sense.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9","6B.6","6B.7"]},{"title":"Amnesty International: DRC president must use second term to tackle human rights crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/drc-president-tshisekedi-must-use-second-term-to-tackle-human-rights-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty said there had been little to no progress on prior pledges, while public resources were squandered and essential services stayed underfunded. That is direct negative evidence against better life chances for ordinary people.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9","6B.2","6B.5"]},{"title":"Amnesty International: DRC president must be held accountable for human rights violations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/drc-president-felix-tshisekedi-must-be-held-accountable-for-human-rights-violations/","summary":"Amnesty said the state of siege militarized everyday life, humanitarian needs remained underfunded, and sexual violence and attacks on civilians were not being prevented or punished. That is severe counterevidence to any claim that ordinary people were left with better life chances.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9","6B.6","6B.7"]},{"title":"Makala prison disaster coverage","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-09-12","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/More-than-260-women-sexually-assaulted-during-Congo-prison-break-UN-reports-shows-47860482/","summary":"Reuters reported at least 129 deaths and more than 260 sexual assaults during the Makala prison escape attempt. This is one of the strongest direct negative signals for ordinary people’s safety and dignity in 2024.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.6","6B.7"]},{"title":"Congo election commission overspent, awarded opaque contracts report","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-15","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-election-commission-overspent-awarded-opaque-contracts-report-2024-01-15/","summary":"A civil-society report said CENI could not account for about $400 million and used opaque procurement. This is negative evidence for clean resource management, which matters because wasted or captured funds reduce the ordinary citizen’s life chances.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.4","6B.5","6B.9"]},{"title":"Tshisekedi sworn in after disputed vote","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-20","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/congolese-president-tshisekedi-sworn-in-for-second-term-after-disputed-vote-3278886","summary":"Tshisekedi entered his second term under a cloud of disputed legitimacy and widespread irregularities. That weakens any claim that 2024 began with a strong, trusted mandate that could readily convert into broad public gains.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Constitutional reform fears","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-10-24","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-president-tshisekedi-draws-criticism-over-constitutional-reform-plans-2024-10-24/","summary":"Reuters reported fears that constitutional reform could remove term limits and open the door to a third term. That is negative evidence for durable, citizen-centered life chances because entrenchment efforts often corrode accountability and future opportunity.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"DR Congo parliament elects speaker in delayed vote","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://theprint.in/world/drc-parliament-elects-speaker-in-delayed-vote-days-after-foiled-coup/2097522/","summary":"Parliament eventually cleared a path for government formation after months of delay. This is weakly favorable procedural evidence, but it is too thin to show that ordinary people’s life chances materially improved.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.7"]},{"title":"DR Congo names new government after months of delay","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-29","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/DR-Congo-names-new-government-after-months-of-delay-46846207/","summary":"The cabinet was finally formed after prolonged bargaining. This suggests basic governing institutions still functioned, but the evidence is procedural rather than a clear welfare gain.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.7"]},{"title":"World Bank human capital blog","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-03-28","url":"https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/investinpeople/prioritizing-human-capital--lessons-from-the-democratic-republic","summary":"The World Bank said conflict in the east was still reducing access to housing, health, education, and basic needs. That is important baseline evidence: many ordinary people were still losing life chances because the crisis environment remained severe.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.6","6B.2","6B.8"]}]}
